summary: Added S03T09 CLI directive enforcement regression coverage. CLI debug compilation now asserts missing required closeout and handoff directive data is carried into command data and emitted bundles, and persisted invalid directive-linked closeout metadata causes doctor and gate closeout to fail closed through JSON error envelopes.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/engine/tsconfig.json apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false AND pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-health.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-regressions.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-compiler.test.ts tests/runtime/runtime-flow.test.ts tests/runtime/import-export-directives.test.ts tests/runtime/core.test.ts AND pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'runs golden-path agent aliases and closeout gates' AND bwrk sync refresh --json AND bwrk gate closeout --strict --auto-prune-operations --json AND bwrk doctor --strict --json
